top_signals.title: Firestorm Labs builds drones aboard USS Essex without shore resupply
top_signals.summary: Service members aboard the USS Essex were able to 3D-print 12 first-person view drones using a containerized microfactory.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Trump-class battleship program will cost $275 billion, CBO report says
top_signals.summary: The Congressional Budget Office estimates the Navy’s new Trump-class battleship program will cost $275 billion, with the first ship costing $23.4 billion.
